name: Basic Pitch (audio → MIDI)
tagline: Spotify's Basic Pitch turns audio into a **MIDI file** you can drag into your DAW. Works best on single instruments, so split stems first.

params.name: tempo
params.help: BPM written into the MIDI file, so it lines up with your project grid.

params.name: frame_threshold
params.help: Higher = notes end sooner, less smearing.

params.name: min_freq
params.help: Hz. 0 = no limit. Use ~30–250 for bass only.

params.name: pitch_bends
params.help: Write pitch bends (for vocals, guitar, synth slides).

params.name: melodia_trick
params.help: Cleans up melody lines. Turn off for chords/polyphony.

params.name: preview
params.help: Also render a quick sine-wave preview so you can hear the MIDI here.

notes:
- Bass, lead lines and vocals transcribe well. Full mixes get messy, so run **Stems** first.
- Set **tempo** to your project BPM before dragging the .mid into Ableton.
